item.title: Russian foreign ministry: ‘There are no grounds to resume political dialogue with Georgia’
item.description: The Russian foreign ministry considers Georgia’s demand to renounce recognition of Abkhazia and South Ossetia’s independence both unrealistic and harmful.

item.description: Giorgi Rukhadze: “They were ready to poison everyone just to save themselves.”

item.description: Armenia’s government has declassified proposals discussed before 2019. What do they reveal? Comments from Armenian experts.

item.description: Although the sale was meant to run for several days, most buyers report system glitches and say they were unable to select a flat.

item.description: In 2023, the Russian government made the state corporation Rosneft the sole fuel supplier to Abkhazia.

item.description: According to Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan, the additional financial reward for skilled work will make the public sector more attractive and competitive.

item.title: ‘Ensuring safety at every inch’: demining effort in Armenia
item.description: Mine detection and disposal is carried out more actively in the border regions. This does not mean that other areas are completely cleared.

item.title: Another archbishop arrested in Armenia over drug-related charges
item.description: Archbishop Arshak Khachatryan is accused of ordering drugs to be planted in the backpack of a protester opposing the Catholicos. Earlier, two other archbishops were arrested in politically motivated cases.
